about: Thresholds approved for Phase 8a and the Phase 6 reference measurements. Safety thresholds are absolute. Latency baselines are only COMPARED (a WARN when more than 1.5x slower) and only on a machine like the one they were taken on.

referenceEnvironment.os: Windows 11 (10.0.26x), Windows PowerShell 5.1, Chrome 157, one 2880x1800 display at about 200%

click.note: zero wrong clicks, zero clicks in refusal cases; every non-success positive must be a safe refusal

capture.note: Phase 6a acceptance: p95 under 150 ms at 1640x1280, no blank frame accepted

busy.note: Phase 6d: a busy window is refused within the 1.5 s bound

idle.note: capture is released after 20 s idle

handles.note: helper handle growth over the resource check (Phase 6e fixed a leak of about 2 per frame)

detection.note: Phase 6b acceptance: end-to-end label accuracy of at least 95%

capture.firstFrame.source: 6e perf: first look incl. session start 0.9-1.0 s

uia.read.p50.source: 6e: UIA read median on the controlled window
